facts.text: I played Super Mario Advance on my Game Boy Advance when I was younger.
Super Mario Advance was one of my favorite games.
I preferred playing as Luigi in Super Mario Advance.
Luigi could jump higher than everyone else in Super Mario Advance, and I liked that.
I loved playing Mario Kart on my Game Boy Advance.
I raced against my friends in Mario Kart on my Game Boy Advance.
I always tried to get the blue shell in Mario Kart.
Getting the blue shell in Mario Kart was satisfying to me because it took out the person in first place.
I loved playing The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap on my Game Boy Advance.
I also remember playing Pokemon Emerald on my Game Boy Advance.
I thought Pokemon Emerald was cool because I could catch and train different Pokemon.
